title: AgentAlgoCollect: a gated registry of agent-assisted algorithm improvements
description: Public registry of algorithm improvements found with AI agents. Each entry carries a label (candidate, confirmed, negative) enforced by a gate script, with raw evidence and a one-command reproduction. Entries were produced with AI agents under human direction. Research material for collection and discussion, not production-ready software. Code: Apache-2.0; text and data: CC BY 4.0.
